attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB 10.11 Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL 7.9) using packages from the MariaDB archive repo plus CentOS-7 vault/EPEL-archive repos for missing base dependencies (pv, perl, rsync, lsof). Verified multi-master write propagation, availability during a single-node outage, automatic IST resync on rejoin, and then completed the mandatory sequential reboot protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and full cluster recovery after each.
